set -e; export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; which git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q git) >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp && rm -rf po && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/camlab-ethz/poseidon po 2>&1|tail -1; cd /tmp/po; pip install -q -e . --no-deps 2>&1|tail -1; pip install -q transformers==4.29.2 accelerate==0.31.0 'huggingface_hub<0.20' wandb einops timm netCDF4 h5py pandas pyyaml matplotlib safetensors psutil 2>&1|tail -1; python - <<'P1'
import re
for pyf, oldmax, nmax in [("scOT/problems/fluids/incompressible.py","20000","2354"),("scOT/problems/reaction_diffusion/allen_cahn.py","15000","3750")]:
    s=open(pyf).read(); s=s.replace(f"{oldmax},", f"{nmax},")
    s=re.sub(r"self\.N_max\s*=\s*\d+", f"self.N_max = {nmax}", s); s=re.sub(r"self\.N_val\s*=\s*\d+", "self.N_val = 64", s); s=re.sub(r"self\.N_test\s*=\s*\d+", "self.N_test = 128", s)
    open(pyf,"w").write(s)
print("SPLIT OK")
P1
echo  | base64 -d > eps_s.py
B() { CJ=$(find "$1" -name config.json 2>/dev/null | grep -v checkpoint- | head -1); dirname "$CJ"; }
VEL=1 DATA=/eu/data/poseidon/_assembled python -u eps_s.py $(B /eu/results/scot_ft_ckpt/NS-PwC_64_velx4) fluids.incompressible.PiecewiseConstants 0 20 0:2 /tmp/a.npz '{"just_velocities": true}'
VEL=0 DATA=/eu/data/poseidon/_assembled python -u eps_s.py $(B /eu/results/scot_ft_ckpt/ACE_64_x4al) reaction_diffusion.AllenCahn 0 19 0:1 /tmp/b.npz
VEL=0 DATA=/eu/data/poseidon/_assembled python -u eps_s.py $(B /eu/results/scot_ft_ckpt/Poisson-Gauss_64_x4) elliptic.poisson.Gaussians 0 1 0:1 /tmp/c.npz
echo ALL_DONE
